scenarios.name: help
scenarios.stdout:
Configurable development workflow and architecture guard

Usage: harness-gate.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  compat      Run the versioned serial compatibility launcher and migration tools
  adapter     Execute a signed out-of-process adapter request
  doctor      Check local tools, configuration, Git, and test database access
  cleanup     Inspect and reclaim stale Harness-Gate resource leases
  scope       Show changed files and the verification components they select
  secrets     Scan file names for high-confidence credential patterns
  audit       Run deterministic architecture rules and write review_context reports
  verify      Run gates and configured steps for the selected profile and components [alias: check]
  hook        Run the staged, fast verification profile used by pre-commit
  parse-logs  Extract one trace's error context from JSON Lines logs
  config      Validate or inspect the repository workflow configuration
  schema      Generate artifacts for the workflow configuration model
  step        Run one configured full-profile step after secrets and audit gates
  init        Initialize .harness-gate configuration from an embedded preset
  presets     List embedded project presets
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --color <COLOR>        Control colored terminal output [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --project-root <PATH>  Override automatic project root discovery
      --config <PATH>        Override the repository workflow configuration file
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version

Examples:
  harness-gate presets
  harness-gate init --preset rust-api
  harness-gate doctor
  harness-gate cleanup --dry-run
  harness-gate verify --all
